Material stories

The Walnut Room

Wood grain, long lines and the warmth of an unhurried morning.

Illustrative concept

Give natural texture room to speak.

Use the direction of wood grain to guide the eye. A continuous horizontal line can make a compact arrangement feel more settled, while taller panels can emphasise the height of a room.

Pair a strong wood texture with quieter surfaces. Collect samples together before deciding: the relationship between the wood tone, floor and worktop matters more than any single finish.
